events.verdict: Bullock (DET) and Hield (SAC) engage and disengage without affecting the other's ability to freely move.
RLB shows Kennard (DET) cleanly dislodges Fox (SAC) of the ball after his gather.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) rests his left forearm against Pachulia's (DET) side during rebounding and makes marginal contact.
Pachulia (DET) and Fox (SAC) tie each other up as they attempt to gain control of the ball; a jump ball is correctly assessed.
Griffin's (DET) left foot steps out-of-bounds along the baseline and he fails to re-establish himself inbounds prior to making contact with the ball.
Griffin (DET) makes clean contact with the ball after Hield's (SAC) gather.
Pachulia (DET) makes incidental contact as he legally contests Hield's (SAC) driving shot attempt.
LLB shows Fox (SAC) reaches in from behind and makes slight contact with Jackson's (DET) right forearm, causing him to momentarily lose control of the ball, which he quickly recovers.
Pachulia (DET) firms up on his left leg in legal screening position as he absorbs the contact from the front of Shumpert's (SAC) left shoulder during the screen.
Hield (SAC) briefly has his arm around Kennard's (DET) midsection before correcting.
[Observable in enhanced video] Griffin (DET) is in the lane for longer than three seconds.
RLS shows Shumpert (SAC) makes brief contact with Bullock's (DET) right arm, which does not affect his ability to maintain control of the ball.
[Observable in enhanced video] Bullock (DET) slides his pivot foot prior to releasing the pass.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) makes marginal contact with Pachulia's (DET) front during the drive that does not affect his SQBR.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) makes marginal contact with Griffin's (DET) off-arm as he is drawn into the air, but Griffin is able to move through the slight contact and finish his shot attempt.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) sets the screen on Bullock (DET) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Hield (SAC) lifts and re-plants his pivot foot to the floor after receiving the pass.
Pachulia (DET) hedges the pick and initiates foot-to-foot contact that trips Hield (SAC) during his dribble.
[Observable in enhanced video] Hield (SAC) lifts and re-plants his pivot foot to the floor after receiving the pass.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) sets the pick on Bullock (DET) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Griffin (DET) briefly engages with Bagley III (SAC) during the rebound.
As the pass is made, Hield (SAC) briefly has his arm around Griffin's (DET) midsection before correcting.
[Observable in enhanced video] Jackson (DET) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Hield (SAC) legally contests Jackson's (DET) jump shot attempt.

Hield (SAC) fumbles the inbound pass and subsequently bats the ball to the floor as he attempts to gain control. He picks up the ball with both hands thereafter, establishing full control, and legally takes one dribble prior to the start of his upward shooting motion.
Brown (DET) briefly places his arm around Fox's (SAC) midsection as the screen is set before correcting.
Pachulia (DET) makes marginal contact with Hield (SAC) after he receives the pass along the perimeter.
